item.title: Matcha Green Tea Powder
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Our Matcha Green Tea Powder is made from high-quality, shade-grown green tea leaves, stone-ground into a fine powder. Known for its rich taste and high antioxidant content, matcha offers a smooth, earthy flavor with a natural sweetness. Perfect for traditional matcha tea or as an ingredient in lattes and smoothies.
